Q3 FFO per Unit was $0.0283; comparison not provided
FFO per Unit is a key REIT operating measure, but the release provides no year-ago comparison to show growth.
Q3 AFFO per Unit was $0.0230; comparison not provided
AFFO indicates cash available for distributions; no prior-period figure is given to assess the change.
NAV per Unit unchanged from Dec. 31, 2025
Stable NAV contrasts with management's longer-term growth aim; the release attributes it partly to lower property fair value.
The change primarily affects Kenwood; management expects the imminent impact on the REIT to be limited.
